description: Free plan only, once per token. If the user posted publicly about deed.page on X or Reddit, pass that post's URL. The server checks that the post is public, mentions deed.page or links to a deed.page site, is from the last 30 days, and was not claimed before, then raises this token's Free limits by 25 sites and to 50 MB per site. Never post on the user's behalf; only send a URL the user gives you. Hobby ($3/mo) is still the bigger upgrade: show the returned user_message, which includes the Hobby link. Inputs: url and token.
